k.t: roleflame is run by Hirobius. Questions about your data go to hello@hirobius.com.
roleflame works without an account. Until you sign in, everything you enter stays in your browser’s local storage on this device.
If you sign in, we store your email address and a copy of what you enter, so it syncs between your devices:
Jobs you save, with their notes, to-dos, interviews and status history
Files you upload, such as final copies of your résumé
Evidence text you paste in to rank openings
Your Application kit: the name, contact details, links and answers you choose to fill in
Your tracks, saved companies, searches and settings
Daily picks: roles, fit notes and draft messages a scheduled assistant adds to your account, only if you set one up with your own feed token. They are deleted after 60 days

roleflame keeps your data, your sign-in session and a few display settings in your browser’s local storage. It also keeps short-lived caches there, such as which job boards it has already checked. We do not use cookies, and we do not track you across other sites.

When roleflame breaks, it sends us a short crash report so we can fix it: the error message and where in the code it happened, which page you were on (for example Pipeline, not which job), and your browser name and version. It never includes your email, account, jobs, notes or documents, and it is not linked to you.
We do not sell your data or use it for advertising. These services help run the app:

Supabase: Sign-in, cloud sync and crash reports. If you sign in, it stores your email address and a copy of your data so it can sync between your devices. It also stores the anonymous crash reports described above.
Vercel: Hosting, and Web Analytics that counts page views without cookies. Like any web host, it sees your IP address and browser details when you load the app.

Public job sources: When you search for openings, check a company or check whether a saved job is still open, your browser may ask these services directly: Hacker News (via Algolia), Remotive, Jobicy, Remote OK, Bluesky and Mastodon (mastodon.social and hachyderm.io) public posts, and the Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee, SmartRecruiters, Teamtailor, Personio, BambooHR, Rippling, Gem, Pinpoint and Breezy HR job boards. They receive your IP address and which search or company board the app is checking, never your notes, documents or account.

Job searches our server runs: If you sign in and your search is for design systems roles, our server (not your browser) looks for openings on designsystems.jobs, Arbeitnow, Remote OK and We Work Remotely and, once each is switched on, TheirStack, Adzuna, Jooble and Into Design Systems. They receive only a fixed search phrase such as “design system”, never your email, jobs, notes, documents or account. Each opening links back to the site it came from and names it; openings from Adzuna are labelled “Jobs by Adzuna”.

DuckDuckGo: Company logos. To show a company’s logo, your browser asks DuckDuckGo’s icon service for the icon of the company’s web address, such as acme.com. It receives that web address and your IP address, and may see that the request came from this app (our site address, never the page or job), but never your name, email, notes, documents or account. Where there is no logo, the app shows the company’s first letter.
Company directories: Finding companies: a public mirror of the Y Combinator company list and GitHub’s public search. They receive your IP address and what you searched for.
Export: Back up in the Menu downloads everything as one file, and Export CSV downloads your jobs as a spreadsheet.

Erasure: when signed in, Delete my data in the Menu removes your synced data from the cloud and from this device. Your sign-in email stays with Supabase until you ask us to remove it; email us and we will.
Signed out, clearing this site’s data in your browser removes everything.
We keep your synced data until you delete it or ask us to. Crash reports are deleted after 90 days. Page-view counts are kept as totals and are not tied to you.
roleflame is not meant for children under 16.
If this policy changes, we will update the date at the top of this page. For a change that affects data you have already given us, we will tell you in the app first.

k.t: roleflame is run by Hirobius. Questions about your data go to hello@hirobius.com.
roleflame works without an account. Until you sign in, everything you enter stays in your browser’s local storage on this device.
If you sign in, we store your email address and a copy of what you enter, so it syncs between your devices:
Jobs you save, with their notes, to-dos, interviews and status history
Files you upload, such as final copies of your résumé
Evidence text you paste in to rank openings
Your Application kit: the name, contact details, links and answers you choose to fill in
Your tracks, saved companies, searches and settings
Daily picks: roles, fit notes and draft messages a scheduled assistant adds to your account, only if you set one up with your own feed token. They are deleted after 60 days

roleflame keeps your data, your sign-in session and a few display settings in your browser’s local storage. It also keeps short-lived caches there, such as which job boards it has already checked. We do not use cookies, and we do not track you across other sites.

When roleflame breaks, it sends us a short crash report so we can fix it: the error message and where in the code it happened, which page you were on (for example Pipeline, not which job), and your browser name and version. It never includes your email, account, jobs, notes or documents, and it is not linked to you.
We do not sell your data or use it for advertising. These services help run the app:

Supabase: Sign-in, cloud sync and crash reports. If you sign in, it stores your email address and a copy of your data so it can sync between your devices. It also stores the anonymous crash reports described above.
Vercel: Hosting, and Web Analytics that counts page views without cookies. Like any web host, it sees your IP address and browser details when you load the app.

Public job sources: When you search for openings, check a company or check whether a saved job is still open, your browser may ask these services directly: Hacker News (via Algolia), Remotive, Jobicy, Remote OK, Bluesky and Mastodon (mastodon.social and hachyderm.io) public posts, and the Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee, SmartRecruiters, Teamtailor, Personio, BambooHR, Rippling, Gem, Pinpoint and Breezy HR job boards. They receive your IP address and which search or company board the app is checking, never your notes, documents or account.

Job searches our server runs: If you sign in and your search is for design systems roles, our server (not your browser) looks for openings on designsystems.jobs, Arbeitnow, Remote OK and We Work Remotely and, once each is switched on, TheirStack, Adzuna, Jooble and Into Design Systems. They receive only a fixed search phrase such as “design system”, never your email, jobs, notes, documents or account. Each opening links back to the site it came from and names it; openings from Adzuna are labelled “Jobs by Adzuna”.

DuckDuckGo: Company logos. To show a company’s logo, your browser asks DuckDuckGo’s icon service for the icon of the company’s web address, such as acme.com. It receives that web address and your IP address, and may see that the request came from this app (our site address, never the page or job), but never your name, email, notes, documents or account. Where there is no logo, the app shows the company’s first letter.
Company directories: Finding companies: a public mirror of the Y Combinator company list and GitHub’s public search. They receive your IP address and what you searched for.
Export: Back up in the Menu downloads everything as one file, and Export CSV downloads your jobs as a spreadsheet.

Erasure: when signed in, Delete my data in the Menu removes your synced data from the cloud and from this device. Your sign-in email stays with Supabase until you ask us to remove it; email us and we will.
Signed out, clearing this site’s data in your browser removes everything.
We keep your synced data until you delete it or ask us to. Crash reports are deleted after 90 days. Page-view counts are kept as totals and are not tied to you.
roleflame is not meant for children under 16.
If this policy changes, we will update the date at the top of this page. For a change that affects data you have already given us, we will tell you in the app first.

DuckDuckGo: Company logos. To show a company’s logo, your browser asks DuckDuckGo’s icon service for the icon of the company’s web address, such as acme.com. It receives that web address and your IP address, and may see that the request came from this app (our site address, never the page or job), but never your name, email, notes, documents or account. Where there is no logo, the app shows the company’s first letter.
Company directories: Finding companies: a public mirror of the Y Combinator company list and GitHub’s public search. They receive your IP address and what you searched for.
Export: Back up in the Menu downloads everything as one file, and Export CSV downloads your jobs as a spreadsheet.

Erasure: when signed in, Delete my data in the Menu removes your synced data from the cloud and from this device. Your sign-in email stays with Supabase until you ask us to remove it; email us and we will.
Signed out, clearing this site’s data in your browser removes everything.
We keep your synced data until you delete it or ask us to. Crash reports are deleted after 90 days. Page-view counts are kept as totals and are not tied to you.
roleflame is not meant for children under 16.
If this policy changes, we will update the date at the top of this page. For a change that affects data you have already given us, we will tell you in the app first.
